info.title: Get Price Detail
info.description: Get the detailed pricing calculation information of an order or a line item, including vouchers, tax, etc.

get.description: Get the detailed pricing calculation information of an order or a line item, including vouchers, tax, etc.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

total.description: Total number of the original price of the order. Calculation: `sku_list_price` + `shipping_list_price`

payment.description: Payment of the order from the buyer. Calculation: `sku_sale_price` + `shipping_sale_price` + `tax_amount` + `small_order_fee`

sku_list_price.description: Total MSRP price of the products.

sku_sale_price.description: Total promotional sale price of the products. Calculation: `sku_list_price` - `subtotal_deduction_seller` - `subtotal_deduction_platform`

subtotal.description: Total promotional sale price of the products including tax. Calculation: `sku_sale_price` + `subtotal_tax_amount`

subtotal_deduction_seller.description: Seller provided price discount on the product

subtotal_deduction_platform.description: Platform provided price discount on the product

subtotal_tax_amount.description: Total tax amount on the product

voucher_deduction_platform.description:
Type of the platform-providing discount on the product. Possible values:
`1010000`: PLATFORM_NEW_USER,
`1020000`: SELLER_SKU_PRICE`,
`1030000`: PLATFORM_FREE_SHIPPING

voucher_deduction_seller.description:
Type of the seller-providing discount on the product. Possible values:
`1010000`: PLATFORM_NEW_USER,
`1020000`: SELLER_SKU_PRICE,
`1030000`: PLATFORM_FREE_SHIPPING`

shipping_sale_price.description: Promotional shipping price Calculation: shipping_list_price - shipping_fee_deduction -shipping_fee_deduction_platform

shipping_fee_deduction_seller.description: Shipping discount covered by the seller.

shipping_fee_deduction_platform.description: Shipping discount covered by the platform

shipping_fee_deduction_platform_voucher.description:
Shipping discount covered by the platform voucher: 
`1010000`: PLATFORM_NEW_USER,
`1020000`: SELLER_SKU_PRICE
`1030000`: PLATFORM_FREE_SHIPPING

tax_amount.description: Total tax amount. Calculation: subtotal_tax_amount + shipping_fee_tax（in TaxDetail） + cod_fee_tax（TaxDetail）

cod_fee.description: COD fee charged by shipping aggregators. For regions outside of Saudi Arabia, the value is `0.00`.

cod_fee_net_amount.description: COD fee charged by shipping aggregators including tax. For regions outside of Saudi Arabia, the value is `0.00`.

sku_gift_original_price.description: Original sku list price of the gift product from the seller.

sku_gift_net_price.description: Original sku list price of the gift product from the seller including tax.

distance_shipping_fee.description:
Distance shipping fee is fee that charged charged by our logistics partner and covers the separate distance-based cost for deliveries outside Java island as a part of Horizon+ Program.
Only applicable in ID Market.

distance_fee.description: Total distance fee for Horizon+ Program. Only applicable for ID market
